## 1. Syllabus & Study Libraries (All 50 NCERT Chapters)

Every chapter across **Physics (042 — 14 chapters)**, **Chemistry (043 — 10 chapters)**, **Biology (044 — 13 chapters)**, and **Mathematics (041 — 13 chapters)** maintains 4 stage checkpoints (`lecture`, `practice`, `ncert`, `pyq`), explicit per-student `ChapterStudyStatus` (`Not Started | In Progress | Reviewed | Completed`), Study Library drawers (`physicsStudyLibrary.ts`, `chemistryStudyLibrary.ts`, `biologyStudyLibrary.ts`, `mathsStudyLibrary.ts`), SVG visual diagrams, and chapter practice links.

---

## 2. Overview CBSE 2027 Date Sheet Countdown & 12th Hackers Player (v3.1)

- **Official CBSE 2027 Date Sheet (`src/data/cbseDateSheet2027.ts` & `BoardCountdownClock.tsx`):** Syncs Overview countdown in IST (`UTC+05:30`) across all 8 official 2027 board exams (Physics `042` on 16 Feb 2027 to Web Application `803` on 9 Apr 2027). Automatically marks ended exams with `✓ Completed` + strikethrough, highlights exam day with `Exam Today`, advances the countdown to the next subject, and hides cleanly (`display: none`) after 9 Apr 2027 at 01:30 PM IST.
- **Forced Landscape Full-Screen in 12th Hackers (`YouTubeSyncPlayer.tsx`):** Appends `fs=0` to every YouTube embed inside 12th Hackers, provides a custom `#231f1e`/`#f8f5f0` bottom-right Full Screen button hidden during full-screen, invokes `requestFullscreen()` + `screen.orientation.lock('landscape')` safely inside `try...catch`, and unlocks orientation on `fullscreenchange`.

---

## 3. Examination Hall v3.1 Architecture

### Governance & Publication Gatekeeper (`canPublishExamPaper`)
- Admits Main Exam Sheets strictly when `status` is `'Approved'` or `'Published'` AND paired with an `'Approved'` or `'Published'` `VerifiedMarkingScheme` covering every question in the sheet.
- Blocks `Draft`, `Under Human Review`, `Archived`, or scheme-incomplete papers via explicit rejection reasons (`AuthorReviewPanel.tsx` in Settings).
- During live timed exams, `stripAnswerKeysForActiveExam` strips `correctIndex` and solution keys from active question payloads.

### Deterministic OMR Evaluator & Immutable Snapshots (`examEvaluator.ts`)
- 8 published Main Sheets (2 per subject: Competitive Paper I `+4/−1`, Board Sprint Paper II `+1/0`).
- Supports 720 Verified Questions (`180/subject`) across `PracticeModeView.tsx` and exam assembly.
- Unconditional post-submission access: even at `0` score or blank attempts, Results expose Question Breakdown, Marking Scheme, immutable `PracticeSheetSnapshot`, Study Library deep-links, Diagrams, and both local A4 PDFs (`Practice Sheet PDF` & `Marking Scheme PDF`).

### 2026–27 SQP Archive (`ArchiveExamView.tsx`)
- Preserves historical v2.6.2 Class 12 CBSE sample papers strictly in read-only Archive view without overwriting Main Sheets or Active Exams.

---

## 4. Multi-Student Isolation & Migration (`v3Storage.ts`)

- `ensureV2ToV3SafeMigration()` initializes v3 student profiles and attempt/status dictionaries without mutating or deleting any of the 17 legacy v2.6.2 `localStorage` keys.
- Attempts, saved OMR drafts, `PracticeSheetSnapshot`s, and `ChapterStudyStatus` records are isolated per student profile (`profileId`).

---

## 5. Multi-Platform Distribution ($0 Free)

- **Web & Offline PWA:** `src/sw.js` (`CACHE_NAME = quadra12-v3.1-*`) + `src/main.tsx` (`quadra12-sw-update` prompt banner in `App.tsx`) + Workbox offline caching.
- **Android Signed APK:** Built via `.github/workflows/android-release.yml` + `scripts/configure-android.mjs` (`versionCode = 3100 + GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER`) preserving permanent keystore secrets (`ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`, `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD`) and `apksigner` SHA-256 verification.
- **Health Endpoint (`server.ts`):** Express serves `GET /api/health` returning `{ ok: true, service: 'quadra12-web', version: '3.1', mode: 'deterministic-local-exam-engine', timestamp }`.
